test_name: Cross-Session Memory Test - Italian Email Preference
description: Test that long-term memory persists across sessions by having user set Italian email preference in session 1, then programmatically start a new session and verify it's remembered in session 2

steps.user_message: What do you know about me?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should respond without mentioning Italian (no previous memory of Italian preference)
steps.agent_response: As an email assistant, I don't have access to personal data about individuals unless it has been shared with me in the course of our conversation. I am designed to respect user privacy and confidentiality. I can store useful information for future conversations when requested, but right now, I don't have any specific information about you.

steps.user_message: I want you to remember that I want all future emails to be written in Italian
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should use update_memory tool to save the Italian email preference
steps.agent_response: Understood! I have saved your preference. All future emails will be written in Italian. Anything else I can assist you with?

steps.user_message: What do you know about me?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should now mention Italian email preference showing that updated memory is used in the session
steps.agent_response: I remember that you prefer all future emails to be written in Italian. Other than that, I do not have any specific information about you.

steps.description: Start a new session to test memory persistence across sessions

steps.user_message: What do you know about me?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should now mention Italian email preference (proving memory persisted across sessions)
steps.agent_response: Based on my long-term memory, I know that you prefer all future emails to be written in Italian.
